data.Documented value: A Longer-Term Evaluation of Information Releases by Influential Market Agents and the Semi-Strong Market Efficiency

This paper is an evaluation of long-term cumulative abnormal returns (CAR's) based on Twitter broadcasts by highly influential market agents. We look at the information content of Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX, Tesla and Twitter Inc. and the former US President Donald Trump. The principal objectives of this research are twofold: 1.) To assess whether markets are semi-strong form efficient and consequentially whether or not returns can be derived from strategies based on such sporadic tweet releases (abstracting from ‘news’). For this purpose, event studies are conducted on multiple companies which were targeted by Musk and Trump tweets. A control group of all Dow Jones companies with earnings releases on Twitter is utilized. We find there appears to be a “pre-post-Twitter-drift” when the release is by exceedingly influential market personalities. The cumulative abnormal returns remain significant over long durations. This indicates that markets are not entirely semi-strong form efficient regarding social media releases and that trading on such tweets may be profitable (even after factoring in varying market phases). 2.) The paper introduces a new theme: long term CAR's of market information events. The paper also notes whether the tweet was during regular market hours or after-market hours.

paragraphs: ### SpaceX, Tesla Earnings to Test Musk's AI Spending Ambitions as Merger Talk Grows [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

In a significant development that could test the boundaries of Elon Musk's ambitions, SpaceX and Tesla are set to release their earnings reports in the coming weeks. This announcement comes amidst growing speculation about a potential merger between the two companies, which could further amplify Musk's spending on artificial intelligence (AI). [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

The acquisition of xAI, Musk's AI company, in 2026, marked a pivotal moment in the evolution of SpaceX's strategy. The company's acquisition of xAI, which was previously operated as the wholly owned subsidiary SpaceXAI, underscores the growing importance of AI in SpaceX's mission to Mars. This move not only aligns with SpaceX's broader goals but also positions the company as a leader in the rapidly expanding field of AI. [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

The joint venture with Tesla, announced in the same year, is another testament to Musk's ambitious plans. The collaboration with Tesla, a company known for its electric vehicles, is expected to leverage Tesla's expertise in electric vehicle technology and AI to create a more comprehensive solution for the future of transportation. This partnership could potentially lead to the development of autonomous vehicles, a key component of Musk's vision for a self-sustaining human colony on Mars. [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

The earnings reports, therefore, will not only provide insight into the financial performance of SpaceX and Tesla but also offer a glimpse into Musk's spending on AI. The combined efforts of SpaceX and Tesla could potentially lead to groundbreaking advancements in AI, robotics, and other fields that could have far-reaching implications for the future of humanity. [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

As the earnings reports are released, the public will be watching closely to see how Musk's ambitious plans for AI are being executed. The success of this merger could further cement Musk's reputation as a visionary leader in the tech industry, while the failure could highlight the challenges of integrating two companies with such different histories and cultures. [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

The earnings reports will also provide a window into the future of SpaceX and Tesla, offering a glimpse into the potential of AI to transform the world. The combined efforts of these two companies could potentially lead to the development of groundbreaking technologies that could change the way we live and work in the future. [[S1|Daily Yield prior News cycle]]

paragraphs: ### SpaceX, Tesla Earnings to Test Musk's AI Spend [[S5|E-Jurnal Akuntansi]] In a significant development, SpaceX and Tesla, two of the most prominent names in the tech and automotive industries, have reported earnings that could test the limits of Elon Musk's ambitious AI spending. The earnings, which are expected to be released shortly, are likely to be closely watched by investors and analysts alike. The earnings report is expected to provide valuable insights into the company's financial health and future prospects, potentially influencing the market's perception of Musk's investment strategy. [[S5|E-Jurnal Akuntansi]] Elon Musk, the founder of Tesla and SpaceX, has been known for his ambitious spending on AI research and development.

His investments in these companies have been driven by his vision to revolutionize the automotive and aerospace industries. However, the high or low return received from an investment will be proportional to the risk borne. Investors can reduce this risk by analyzing the factors that cause risk from information that makes the capital market react. This research aims to determine the reaction of the Indonesian capital market to investment plans between the Indonesian government and the founders of Tesla and SpaceX by calculating abnormal returns and trading volume activity of metal and mineral industrial companies listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

[[S5|E-Jurnal Akuntansi]] [[S5|E-Jurnal Akuntansi]] The research uses the event study method, which involves analyzing the abnormal returns and trading volume activity of metal and mineral industrial companies listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange. The observation period was carried out for 7 working days, and the sampling method used was non-probability sampling with purposive sampling technique. The research results show that there are no significant abnormal returns on investment plan announcements, but the test results on trading volume activity show significant results. This suggests that investors may be more inclined to react to trading volume activity than to the announcement of investment plans.

[[S5|E-Jurnal Akuntansi]] The findings of this research are significant as they provide valuable insights into the market's perception of Musk's investment strategy. The results of the research can be used to inform investors and analysts about the potential risks and rewards associated with investing in Tesla and SpaceX. This information can help investors make more informed decisions and reduce the risk of investing in these companies.
